summary: Ardmore Shipping Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis. This is a routine periodic report under the 1934 Act, not a special situation. The filing includes standard financial data, credit facility details, and share information but does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as the equivalent of a quarterly report on Form 10-Q. The filing is a normal course update with no extraordinary corporate event.
